notes: Kalshi public trade-API v2, read-only, no credentials (D-016): four streams per pull — markets (settlements + strikes, the 14-column shape the on-disk store also carries), candles (hourly), fee_schedules (fee_type/fee_multiplier per series — rates are per-SERIES and read from the venue, never hard-coded, I-001) and orderbooks (a capture of every OPEN market's book, so a live recorder is `acquire --mode live` on a schedule). The universe is the temperature/gas/copper ladder family the inventory tracks; add a series here when its usable-event count crosses the eligibility bar, never by editing code. Pacing is serial by design — the public API throttles per IP. Register with: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source kalshi --connector kalshi --config @configs/source-kalshi.json --catalog-source <P1 source> --activate.
